answer: A nebula looks uniform from afar, yet every star inside it differs, and identities should be judged the same way. Give each account a seasonal reputation that decays unless renewed through distinct community roles - moderating, reviewing, mentoring - so a farm cannot keep shells alive by repeating one cheap action. A jetty reaches the water because it rests on basalt; likewise, standing should rest on varied, verifiable roles, not one credential. Rotating roles each season forces operators to staff real skills across many accounts, which scales poorly, while honest users renew naturally.
